property_summary: For any caller and any deposited positive amount, after withdrawAll returns successfully the caller's credit is zero in the reference contract; the mutant that omits zeroing can leave credit non-zero (or allow a second successful withdrawal) when the recipient re-enters during the external call, so a re-entrant receiver can make the mutant violate this invariant.
change_summary: Delete zeroing of the caller's credit so repeated withdrawAll calls may succeed or revert differently (observable behavior changes).
